title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO amid ongoing intelligence probe
content: Nvidia shares surged nearly 29% after the company’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO following consultations with the US government.

title: Trump-linked American Bitcoin secures $150M credit line from FalconX

title: Strategy buys 457 Bitcoin, spends $212M on preferred share buybacks

title: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO Days After Board Ruled Out His Return

title: Morning Minute: Crypto Rebounds after NVDA Drives Friday Selloff

title: Strategy Buys $30M in Bitcoin, Moves $1B From USD Reserve to Cash Pot

title: Czech Authorities Charge 15 Over $12M Unlicensed Crypto Casino
content: Investigators say "decentralized" casino BETFIN was run centrally, inflated its player numbers with bots and made $12 million illegally.

title: Solana Meme Coin for Fiona the Hippo Raises $100K for Cincinnati Zoo Charity
content: A meme coin honoring the Cincinnati Zoo's late pygmy hippo has sent its creator rewards to the zoo's nonprofit.

title: Bitcoin Core Patches Node-Stall Bug Found by Block’s AI Scanner
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Core Patches Node-Stall Bug Found by Block’s AI Scanner Bitcoin Core fixed a medium-severity bug that could freeze a node’s block processing for over a dozen seconds per message, a flaw first found by Spiral’s Project Loupe AI scanner. This post Bitcoin Core Patches Node-Stall Bug Found by Block’s AI Scanner first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Bitcoin Price Surges Above $64,000 as Nvidia Reinstates CEO
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Surges Above $64,000 as Nvidia Reinstates CEO The bitcoin price surged to near $63,700 on Monday as Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, sending stocks, crypto equities and bitcoin miners sharply higher. This post Bitcoin Price Surges Above $64,000 as Nvidia Reinstates CEO first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: UK FCA Bars Crypto Exchanges From Market Making on Their Own Venues
content: Bitcoin Magazine UK FCA Bars Crypto Exchanges From Market Making on Their Own Venues The FCA's final rules bar U.K. crypto exchange operators from trading against their own capital on venues they run from Oct. 25, 2027, while a Treasury order clears third-party market makers to trade without a dealing permission. This post UK FCA Bars Crypto Exchanges From Market Making on Their Own Venues first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Strategy (MSTR) Adds 457 Bitcoin for $29.6 million
content: Bitcoin Magazine Strategy (MSTR) Adds 457 Bitcoin for $29.6 million Strategy bought 457 bitcoin for $29.6 million last week, lifting holdings to 851,305 BTC at an average cost of $75,446, an 8-K filing shows. This post Strategy (MSTR) Adds 457 Bitcoin for $29.6 million first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: American Bitcoin (ABTC) Lands $150 Million Bitcoin-Backed Credit Line From FalconX
content: Bitcoin Magazine American Bitcoin (ABTC) Lands $150 Million Bitcoin-Backed Credit Line From FalconX American Bitcoin signed a two-year, $150 million revolving credit line with FalconX secured by its bitcoin, letting the Hut 8-backed miner raise cash without selling its reserve. This post American Bitcoin (ABTC) Lands $150 Million Bitcoin-Backed Credit Line From FalconX first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
